verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing and money-movement platform, so scheduled recurring jobs (such as recurring transfers or workflows) is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a user-configurable scheduler or recurring workflow. Velocity controls ("weekly spending limit") are time-bounded spend rules, not scheduled jobs. The "daily reconciliation" claim describes Highnote's internal operations team, not a scheduling capability exposed to users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
